question: 按分支统计 2005 年佣金收入，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT db.Branch AS branch, SUM(ft.Commission) AS commission_revenue FROM iceberg_rest.atlas.dwd_fact_trades ft JOIN iceberg_rest.atlas.dwd_dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN iceberg_rest.atlas.dwd_dim_broker db ON ft.SK_BrokerID = db.SK_BrokerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2005 GROUP BY db.Branch ORDER BY commission_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 佣金是经纪服务收取的费用
营业部/分支是组织的子单元（OMG Commons）
